W.note: 5-7-5 (af-ter-the-storm-waves 5; a-sky-I-did-not-ask-for 7; held-out-in-both-hands 5), a warm turn of gift, but rare clouds are barely evoked (only 'waves').

X.note: 5-7-5 (mother-of-pearl sheets 5; na-cre-ous light on cold air 7; dawn the sky holds brief 5), accurate nacreous clouds but reads like a list of stock epithets.

Y.note: 5-7-5 (na-cre-ous glow burns 5; in the long dark before dawn 7; mother-of-pearl sky 5), true to polar stratospheric glow before sunrise, though the ending repeats the stock name.

Z.note: 5-7-5 (mother-of-pearl cloud 5; I hold out cold hands to catch 7; colour draining off 5), the cupped hands and fading colour give a physical image and a real turn about impermanence.
